title: T-DIG: Text-Conditioned Diversity for Image Generation
title_zh: T-DIG：面向图像生成的文本条件多样性

paragraphs.en: T-DIG用LLM策略结合GRPO训练，按用户指定维度生成多样化提示，提升文生图的多图像多样性且保持对齐。 Text-to-image (T2I) platforms typically return several images per prompt so users can explore different visual interpretations and choose one that matches their intent. However, T2I models are usually optimized for single-image quality which comes at a cost of multi-image diversity, limiting this exploration. Diversity is also contextual: one user wants variations in background, while another wants them in artistic style, and the same user may later want variations in clothing. The generated images should differ along whatever axis the user cares about. In this paper, we introduce T-DIG, a text-conditioned diversity framework for image generation and editing. T-DIG is an iterative framework comprising multiple modules that lets users type prompts, inspect default generations, request variations using natural language, and continue refining outputs until they're satisfied. At its core, T-DIG uses an LLM policy that produces K axis-conditioned prompts or edit instructions for a frozen generator or editor. We train this policy with GRPO using a text-conditioned diversity reward and alignment penalties. Because the image generator remains frozen, T-DIG applies to open-weight, distilled, and proprietary models. We also release the first dataset for text-conditioned prompt diversity in image generation, with the training and validation splits built from human-written axes and a test set drawn from real user interactions with T-DIG. T-DIG far exceeds baselines in improving text-conditioned diversity, while preserving base-prompt alignment across a variety of metrics and human judgements. We show that user-directed diversity exploration can be added to a wide range of image generation models, open and closed, without the need to access their weights. Website: https://image-study.org/t-dig/
paragraphs.zh: T-DIG用LLM策略结合GRPO训练，按用户指定维度生成多样化提示，提升文生图的多图像多样性且保持对齐。文生图（T2I）平台通常会针对每个提示返回多张图像，以便用户探索不同的视觉呈现并选择符合其意图的一张。 然而，T2I模型通常针对单张图像质量进行优化，这以牺牲多图像多样性为代价，限制了这种探索。 多样性还取决于上下文：一位用户想要背景上的变化，另一位用户想要艺术风格上的变化，而同一位用户之后可能想要服装上的变化。 生成的图像应当在用户所关心的任何维度上有所不同。 在本文中，我们提出T-DIG，一个面向图像生成与编辑的文本条件化多样性框架。 T-DIG是一个由多个模块组成的迭代式框架，让用户可以输入提示、查看默认生成结果、用自然语言请求变化，并持续优化输出直到满意为止。 T-DIG的核心是使用一个LLM策略，为冻结的生成器或编辑器生成K个按维度条件化的提示或编辑指令。 我们使用文本条件化多样性奖励和对齐惩罚，通过GRPO训练该策略。 由于图像生成器保持冻结，T-DIG适用于开放权重模型、蒸馏模型和专有模型。 我们还发布了首个面向图像生成中文本条件化提示多样性的数据集，其训练集和验证集基于人工撰写的维度构建，测试集则取自用户与T-DIG的真实交互。 T-DIG在提升文本条件化多样性方面远超基线方法，同时在多种指标和人类评判下保持了与基础提示的对齐。 我们表明，用户主导的多样性探索可以被添加到广泛的图像生成模型中，无论是开放还是闭源模型，且无需访问其权重。 网站：https://image-study.org/t-dig/
